intro.title: AI Nutrition
intro.body: PacerGo can recommend your daily nutrition targets based on your body data, activity and fitness goal.
intro.reuse: We'll use what's already in your fitness profile and only ask for anything missing.
intro.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

guidance.proteinPerMeal: Spread your protein over {{meals}} meals — about {{grams}} g each.
guidance.proteinFoods: Easy protein sources: chicken breast, eggs, fish, tofu, unsweetened soy milk, Greek yogurt.
guidance.goal_lose_weight: Fill half your plate with vegetables, choose lean protein, and swap sugary drinks for water or unsweetened tea.
guidance.goal_build_muscle: Have a carb + protein meal or snack within about 2 hours after training (e.g. chicken rice, or a banana with soy milk).
guidance.goal_stay_healthy: Build balanced plates: ½ vegetables, ¼ protein, ¼ whole grains such as brown rice or sweet potato.
guidance.goal_functional: Fuel mixed training with steady carbs around sessions and enough protein to support strength and recovery.
guidance.activity_low: With a mostly seated day, keep portions moderate and favor high-fiber foods that keep you full.
guidance.activity_high: Active days burn more — include enough carbs (rice, noodles, fruit) to keep your energy up.
guidance.hydration: Drink about {{liters}} L of water a day, more on hot days and training days.

nutrition.editInProfile: Calories follow your Fitness Profile. Your protein target stays when you create a new training plan — change it here, or use the suggestion when your goal changes.
